names: Squats day — front squat + upper, 9,670 kg

en.eNote: No meals logged for Aug 9 – Aug 15 (last intake log: Jun 14), so the energy and burn charts assume the 2,000 kcal plan. Garmin active burn averaged ~436 kcal/day, essentially unchanged from ~439 last window, peaking 941 on Monday's swim-plus-SUP day and 830 on Tuesday, with Thursday's gym session adding 629. Friday was a real rest day at 79 kcal, and today reads 0 — nothing recorded yet this morning.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414 (today's Garmin BMR reads 684 because the day is incomplete). Intake assumes 2,000 kcal all seven days (none logged after Jun 14), so the implied balance ≈ −850 kcal/day is exercise-driven, not measured. Saturday (Aug 15) has barely started.
en.wNote: Bridge shows the last logged meals (Jun 12–14) — no intake was logged for the displayed week. Negative balance = deficit.
en.i1t: Two days off the gym — the window is holding, not building
en.i1: 7 sessions across 5 active days, 4h 18m and ~3,054 active kcal — against 7 sessions, 4h 18m and ~3,075 kcal in the Aug 8 – Aug 14 window. The numbers barely moved because the week barely moved: Saturday the 8th (a rest day) rolled off the back and today rolled on empty, so the same five working days sit in the middle. Water work stands at two open-water swims totalling 2,286 m and four SUP paddles totalling 7,101 m, both unchanged. The one gym session is Thursday's, now two days back, and no tonnage has been logged since. Friday was a clean rest day — 79 active kcal, max HR 110, the quietest day since Aug 8.
en.i2t: Still the only lift on the board: 9,670 kg, front squat capped at 80 kg
en.i2: Thursday 16:40 to 17:45 — 67 minutes, 603 kcal, avg 118 bpm and a max of 156, still the highest heart rate of the window against Monday's 154. Sixteen sets, 165 reps, 9,670 kg across five exercises. Front squat led at 60×6, then 80×10, 80×6, 80×6 — a deliberately conservative top load for a first day back after fourteen days off. Lat pulldown ran 65, 65, 70 kg for 12s, chest press 65, 70, 70 with reps slipping 12/12/10, leg curl climbed 40/45/50, and the closing shoulder press faded hard: 40×12, 40×10, then 35×6. Two days on, nothing has been added: the lift-HR chart is still frozen because front squat is not one of the three tracked lifts, so trap-bar, hack squat and goblet squat end at Jun 20, Jul 28 and Jun 11 respectively.
en.i3t: All streams clean — nothing new to sync
en.i3: Seven consecutive recorded nights with HRV on each and no empty slots on the chart. Hevy and Intervals.icu were both synced before this refresh and neither returned anything new — Thursday's workout remains the last entry, so the 9,670 kg figure is still measured rather than estimated. Garmin ran clean through this morning; last night's sleep landed at 06:07 and today's daily totals are still near zero because the day has just begun.
en.i4t: Recovery: the bedtime fix worked, duration is still short
en.i4: Last night ran 6h 01m for a score of 76 — up 8 from Thursday's 68 and 53 minutes longer, because lights out moved from 00:44 back to 23:59. It is still 1h 14m under the 7h 15m average and the second-shortest night of the window. Efficiency was the best of the seven nights at 98% with only 7 minutes awake. The stages inverted: deep dropped to 66 minutes from 100 (18% of the night, back inside the normal band), REM recovered to 62 from 50 and light rebounded to 233 from 158. HRV turned for the first time in four nights — 38, up 4 and 2 over the 36 average, breaking the 33, 34, 34 run. RHR is the laggard at 55, unchanged and still top of its 53–55 band. Morning stress 22, the lowest of the window. Readiness 71, moderate. Yesterday's full rest day is most of why.
en.rec: Yesterday's call was to rest and get to bed earlier, and both happened: 79 active kcal, lights out at 23:59, HRV up 4 and stress down to 22. Readiness 71 is not a green light for a hard day but it is enough for the Saturday strength session the plan asked for. Do it, and put a tracked lift in it — that was the whole point. Hack squat has not been logged since Jul 28 at 185 kg and trap-bar not since Jun 20, so the per-set HR chart has been blind for weeks; open hack squat at 150–160 kg, five or six working sets, and the series picks up with a clean reading rather than a guess. Keep front squat where it was or leave it out entirely — 80 kg was the right conservative number on Thursday and there is no reason to chase it two days later on 6h of sleep. Total tonnage around 9,000–10,000 kg is the target, not more. The one thing that has not resolved is RHR: 55 for the third straight morning and pinned at the top of its band, which usually clears a day or two after sleep duration does. That means the evening matters more than the session — train in the late afternoon if you like, but the 23:00 bedtime has to hold tonight too, and duration needs to get back over seven hours before the next hard day. Next: hack squat 150–160 kg today, easy water work or rest Sunday, lights out before 23:00 both nights.

hr.eNote: Nema zabilježenih obroka za 9.–15.8. (zadnji unos: 14.6.), pa grafovi energije i potrošnje pretpostavljaju planskih 2.000 kcal. Garmin aktivna potrošnja prosj. ~436 kcal/dan, praktički nepromijenjeno naspram ~439 prethodnog prozora, vrhunac 941 u ponedjeljak (plivanje + SUP) i 830 u utorak, uz 629 od četvrtkove teretane. Petak je bio pravi dan odmora sa 79 kcal, a danas pokazuje 0 — jutros još ništa nije zabilježeno.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414 (današnji Garminov BMR pokazuje 684 jer dan nije završen). Unos pretpostavlja 2.000 kcal svih sedam dana (ništa zabilježeno nakon 14.6.), pa je implicirana bilanca ≈ −850 kcal/dan posljedica treninga, ne mjerena. Subota (15.8.) tek je počela.
hr.wNote: Most prikazuje zadnje zabilježene obroke (12.–14.6.) — za prikazani tjedan nema unosa. Negativna bilanca = deficit.
hr.i1t: Dva dana bez teretane — prozor se drži, ali ne raste
hr.i1: 7 treninga kroz 5 aktivnih dana, 4h 18m i ~3.054 aktivnih kcal — naspram 7 treninga, 4h 18m i ~3.075 kcal u prozoru 8.–14.8. Brojke se jedva pomaknule jer se tjedan jedva pomaknuo: subota 8. (dan odmora) ispala je sa stražnjeg kraja, a danas je ušao prazan, pa u sredini stoji istih pet radnih dana. Rad u vodi stoji na dva plivanja na moru ukupno 2.286 m i četiri veslanja na SUP-u ukupno 7.101 m, oboje nepromijenjeno. Jedina teretana je četvrtkova, sada dva dana iza, i od tada nema zabilježene tonaže. Petak je bio čist dan odmora — 79 aktivnih kcal, maksimalni puls 110, najmirniji dan od 8.8.
hr.i2t: I dalje jedini trening snage na ploči: 9.670 kg, prednji čučanj ograničen na 80 kg
hr.i2: Četvrtak od 16:40 do 17:45 — 67 minuta, 603 kcal, prosjek 118 otkucaja i maksimum od 156, i dalje najviši puls u prozoru naspram ponedjeljkovih 154. Šesnaest serija, 165 ponavljanja, 9.670 kg kroz pet vježbi. Prednji čučanj je vodio s 60×6, pa 80×10, 80×6, 80×6 — namjerno konzervativna gornja težina za prvi dan povratka nakon četrnaest dana pauze. Povlačenje na lat mašini išlo je 65, 65, 70 kg po 12, potisak za prsa 65, 70, 70 uz pad ponavljanja 12/12/10, pregib potkoljenice rastao je 40/45/50, a zaključni potisak za ramena osjetno je popustio: 40×12, 40×10, pa 35×6. Dva dana kasnije ništa nije dodano: graf pulsa po serijama i dalje stoji jer prednji čučanj nije jedno od tri praćena podizanja, pa trap-bar, hack čučanj i goblet čučanj završavaju 20.6., 28.7. odnosno 11.6.
hr.i3t: Svi tokovi čisti — nema ništa novo za sinkronizirati
hr.i3: Sedam uzastopnih zabilježenih noći, HRV upisan na svakoj, bez praznih mjesta na grafu. Hevy i Intervals.icu sinkronizirani su prije ovog osvježavanja i nijedan nije vratio ništa novo — četvrtkov trening ostaje zadnji zapis, pa je podatak od 9.670 kg i dalje izmjeren, a ne procijenjen. Garmin je radio čisto do jutros; sinoćnji san stigao je u 06:07, a današnji dnevni zbrojevi još su blizu nule jer je dan tek počeo.
hr.i4t: Oporavak: popravak lijeganja je upalio, trajanje je i dalje kratko
hr.i4: Sinoć je noć trajala 6h 01m uz ocjenu 76 — osam više od četvrtkovih 68 i 53 minute dulje, jer se gašenje svjetla pomaknulo s 00:44 natrag na 23:59. I dalje je 1h 14m ispod prosjeka od 7h 15m i druga najkraća noć u prozoru. Učinkovitost je bila najbolja od svih sedam noći, 98% uz samo 7 minuta budnosti. Faze su se obrnule: duboki san pao je na 66 minuta sa 100 (18% noći, natrag u normalni raspon), REM se oporavio na 62 s 50, a lagani san skočio na 233 sa 158. HRV se prvi put u četiri noći okrenuo — 38, četiri više i dva iznad prosjeka od 36, čime je prekinut niz 33, 34, 34. RHR zaostaje na 55, nepromijenjen i i dalje na vrhu raspona 53–55. Jutarnji stres 22, najniže u prozoru. Spremnost 71, umjerena. Jučerašnji potpuni odmor najveći je dio razloga.
hr.rec: Jučerašnja preporuka bila je odmor i ranije lijeganje, i oboje se dogodilo: 79 aktivnih kcal, gašenje svjetla u 23:59, HRV viši za četiri i stres pao na 22. Spremnost 71 nije zeleno svjetlo za težak dan, ali je dovoljna za subotnji trening snage koji je plan tražio. Odradi ga i stavi u njega praćeno podizanje — to je i bila cijela poanta. Hack čučanj nije zabilježen od 28.7. na 185 kg, a trap-bar od 20.6., pa je graf pulsa po serijama tjednima slijep; otvori hack čučanj na 150–160 kg, pet ili šest radnih serija, i niz se nastavlja s čistim očitanjem umjesto procjene. Prednji čučanj ostavi gdje je bio ili ga izbaci — 80 kg bila je ispravna konzervativna brojka u četvrtak i nema razloga juriti je dva dana kasnije na šest sati sna. Ukupna tonaža od oko 9.000–10.000 kg je cilj, ne više. Jedino što se nije riješilo je RHR: 55 treće jutro zaredom i prikovan na vrhu svog raspona, što se obično sredi dan-dva nakon što se sredi trajanje sna. To znači da je večer važnija od samog treninga — treniraj kasno poslijepodne ako želiš, ali lijeganje u 23:00 mora izdržati i večeras, a trajanje se mora vratiti preko sedam sati prije sljedećeg teškog dana. Sljedeće: hack čučanj 150–160 kg danas, lagani rad u vodi ili odmor u nedjelju, gašenje svjetla prije 23:00 obje noći.
